reasons.title: A bidder is listed with a revoked licence marker
reasons.detail: ST. GERRARD CONSTRUCTION GEN. CONTRACTOR & DEVELOPMENT CORP. (FORMERLY:ST. GERRARD CONSTRUCTION) ([REVOKED] 31762): DPWH lists this name with a [REVOKED] licence marker
reasons.evidence: DPWH's own record shows “[REVOKED]” next to the bidder's licence number.
checks: Look the firm up on the PCAB “verify a contractor” page (pcab.construction.gov.ph/verify).
Check whether the licence was revoked before the bid date, and whether that bidder won.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: St. Gerrard Construction Gen. Contractor & Development Corp. ([Revoked] 31762): 2 of 260 earlier road contracts terminated; Sto. Cristo Construction & Trading Inc. (For: Sto. Cristo Construction & Trading): 1 of 135 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.
